mentions.name: asm.build
mentions.description: A package manager for assembly projects. Its thesis is that programming languages existed as an abstraction for humans: as AI makes writing code cheap, code can be written in assembly for each architecture as long as specifications are done well, and runtime costs matter more — so have your AI write assembly instead of Rust.
mentions.problem: Programming languages exist as abstractions for humans; as writing code becomes cheaper, the costs of running matter more, so code should be generated per architecture in assembly rather than in higher-level languages like Rust.
